**Our Tech Stack: https://stackshare.io/companies/sedna

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of Sedna together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.

Here’s what that looks like day to day

• In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

• You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

• You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

• You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

• You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

• Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

• Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

• Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

• Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

• Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

• Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You’re a great match if

• You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

• You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

• You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

• You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

• You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

• You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

• Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

• Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

• Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

• Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

• You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

• You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

• You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

• You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

• You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

• You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

Practicalities

• We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

• For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

• We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

• Our working language is English.

We offer

• Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

• A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

• Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

• A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

• Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

• Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

• Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

• Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

• Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

• Pension plan and private health insurance.

• Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

**Empower our stores to drive B2B growth through a world-class Sales application

**Join us as our new Senior Backend Engineer and come play a pivotal role in evolving the Sales application - the critical engine that enables all our stores to sell to B2B customers across the STARK Group.

You will join a team at the heart of our commercial digital transformation. In this role, you won’t just be writing code; you will be building the scalable architecture that allows our business to handle complex B2B sales flows, ensuring that our stores have the reliability and performance they need to serve professional craftsmen effectively.

You will blend deep hands-on engineering with architectural thinking, helping us transition from legacy constraints to a modern, composable, and cloud-native landscape.

**What You'll Be Doing

**You will take a senior role in the continued development of the Sales application, working closely with fellow engineers, architects and business stakeholders to turn complex B2B requirements into technical solutions.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will, among other things:

• Lead the design and implementation of robust backend services that power the B2B sales experience.

• Strengthen the system’s reliability and performance, ensuring a seamless experience for users in our stores.

• Evolve our microservice and event-driven architecture, including Kafka-based communication and integrations with core commercial services such as Pricing.

• Safeguard the long-term technical health of the application by championing clean architecture, SOLID principles, and rigorous testing.

• Mentor junior developers, conducting impactful code reviews and raising the overall engineering bar of the team.

• Ensure high data integrity and performance within our PostgreSQL databases.

**What We Offer

**The Sales app is a cornerstone of STARK Group’s ability to compete and grow in the B2B market. By building a high-performance backend, you are directly impacting the daily work of thousands of employees and the experience of our professional customers.

Your work ensures that the transition from “legacy” to “modern” isn’t just a change in technology, but a leap in how the business can operate - enabling pricing agility, better margin visibility, and a superior sales flow.

**Who We Are Looking For

**You are an experienced backend engineer who thrives on solving complex problems and turning ambiguous business needs into structured, scalable code. You are a “technical leader by example” who cares as much about the maintainability of the code as you do about the feature delivery.

From a technical perspective, we expect that you:

• Have 5–10 years of professional experience in software development, with a strong experience in C# and the .NET ecosystem.

• Have a strong track record of building microservices and distributed systems in cloud environments (preferably Azure).

• Are experienced with event-driven architectures and have hands on experience with messaging systems (e.g., Kafka).

• Have deep knowledge of relational databases, specifically PostgreSQL.

• Are well-versed in engineering best practices, including Clean Architecture, DDD, SOLID, and automated testing.

• Have experience deploying and monitoring applications using Kubernetes, Argo, and Grafana.

In addition, it is an advantage if you:

• Have experience with B2B sales processes or large-scale e-commerce logic.

• Have a general understanding of AI integration within software development to improve productivity or feature sets.

• Have worked in a matrix organization within a large-scale digital transformation programme.

Overall, you bring a pragmatic approach to engineering. You care about building solutions the right way, while recognising that strong engineering is also about balancing technical quality with the need to deliver business value.

**Welcome to Group IT

**Group IT is at the heart of STARK Group’s digital transformation. We are replacing legacy systems and building a modular, scalable, cloud-native IT landscape that supports our international business.

You’ll be part of a modern engineering environment where platform capabilities, developer experience, and operational excellence are central to how we deliver value—and where your contribution will have a direct impact on business outcomes.

**Want to know more and apply?

**We will be happy to answer any questions you may have regarding the position and your options in STARK Group. You are welcome to contact Mads Rahbek, Engineering Manager, at mads.rahbek.lindvang@stark.dk for any specific questions regarding the role.

**STARK Group

**STARK Group is a growing private equity-owned company with a strong legacy. STARK Group was first established in Denmark in 1896 and has today evolved into a leading European retailer and distributor of heavy building materials with net sales of approx. EUR 9 billion. With a dedicated team of more than 20,000 employees and +1,150 branches and distribution centres across the Nordics, Greenland, Germany, Austria and the UK, we live and breathe to serve professional craftsmen with heavy building materials all the way from the Austrian Alps to Tromsø, close to the Arctic circle and everywhere in between. STARK Group is committed to reach net zero emissions by 2050 across the entire business, is a signatory to the UN Global Compact, and works within fully 2030 validated science-based targets to keep global warming below 1.5°C At STARK Group IT, we believe in the richness diversity brings. We invite individual of all backgrounds to join us in creating and inclusive and welcoming environment. We believe in a workplace where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work.

**Agency Policy

**STARK Group IT appreciates the interest of all candidates. However, we prefer to directly engage with individuals seeking employment opportunities. Therefore, we kindly request recruitment agencies, head-hunters, and third-party staffing services to refrain from contacting us regarding this job posting. All applications should be submitted directly by the candidates through our official application process. We value direct communication and look forward to reviewing your application.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Why this role is important

**The Principal SaaS Solution Advisor plays a critical role in supporting the growth of SimCorp's SaaS and SimCorp One offerings across new and existing client opportunities. Working closely with Sales, Account Management, and internal product and delivery teams, you act as a trusted advisor to prospects — guiding them through the strategic, commercial, and operational considerations of adopting a cloud-hosted, managed investment management platform.

Your focus is to shape and progress opportunities across the full presales lifecycle, from initial discovery and solution scoping through to RFP responses, tailored demonstrations, and competitive positioning. You bring both deep product fluency across SimCorp's evolving portfolio and genuine industry expertise, enabling you to engage credibly at the senior level and position SimCorp's SaaS and SimCorp One offering as a compelling answer to the challenges reshaping the investment management industry.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

****Discovery & Scoping

**

• Engage prospects in structured discovery to understand their operating model, technology estate, regulatory environment, and strategic priorities.

• Translate functional and non-functional requirements into an indicative SaaS or SimCorp One solution scope, covering platform configuration, data services, connectivity, and managed service boundaries.

• Identify and document client-specific pain points and map them to SimCorp differentiators — including the SimCorp One open platform model, continuous delivery, and the reduced total cost of ownership relative to on-premise alternatives.

• Surface potential fit gaps early and provide structured feedback to Product and SaaS Operations.

**RFPs & Commercial Responses

**

• Lead or contribute to RFP responses for SaaS and SimCorp One opportunities, with focus on deployment model, service levels, data residency, security posture, and total cost of ownership.

• Articulate the SaaS and SimCorp One commercial model clearly — subscription structure, included services, upgrade inclusion, and open ecosystem positioning — in a way that resonates with procurement, finance, and technology stakeholders.

• Build and maintain a knowledge base of SaaS and SimCorp One RFP responses, keeping content current and aligned with contractual and operational commitments.

**Workshops, Scoping & Solution Validation

**

• Plan and deliver tailored workshops, scoping sessions, and architecture design discussions that help prospects understand the SimCorp One SaaS operating model, deployment approach, and managed service boundaries.

• Prepare and present compelling service descriptions, solution presentations, and platform overviews — adapting content and depth to the audience, from operational teams to C-level stakeholders.

• Design and facilitate workshops covering topics such as the shared responsibility model, release management, environment strategy, and the SimCorp One partner and data ecosystem.

• Where appropriate, support Solution Validation engagements, defining scope and success criteria aligned to the prospect's decision framework.

**SimCorp One & SaaS Proposition

**

• Develop and maintain deep knowledge of SimCorp One — its open platform architecture, API-first design, partner integrations, and the strategic direction of moving clients from on-premise deployments toward a composable, cloud-native operating model.

• Articulate clearly how SimCorp One differs from traditional SaaS delivery: the ability to connect third-party solutions, consume data services, and operate within a broader fintech ecosystem while retaining SimCorp Dimension as the investment book of record.

• Engage confidently with CTO, COO, and CIO-level stakeholders on cloud strategy, platform extensibility, vendor dependency, and the long-term operating model implications of the SimCorp One platform.

• Understand and articulate the value of SimCorp One Neo — SimCorp's embedded AI layer — including its agentic workflows, prompt library, and human-in-the-loop design, and position these capabilities as part of the broader SaaS and SimCorp One value proposition in client conversations.

**How You Contribute To The Team

**

• Partner closely with Sales Specialists and Account Management to ensure consistent and compelling messaging to prospects and business partners.

• Provide feedback on competitive positioning and product gaps based on prospect and market insights.

• Coordinate with broader presales and delivery colleagues to ensure continuity and quality across the opportunity lifecycle.

• Contribute to the ongoing improvement of SaaS and SimCorp One Solution Advisory tooling, decks and material.

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you see yourself thriving in the role described above. How you acquired the relevant skills matters less than your ability and willingness to apply them and continue learning.

Ideally, you bring experience in several of the following areas:

• A minimum of 7 years’ experience in investment management technology, in a presales, solution advisory, or senior implementation capacity.

• Deep understanding of buy-side operating models across asset managers, asset owners, insurance companies, or wealth managers — including front-to-back investment workflows, data management, and the pressures driving technology transformation.

• Fluency in industry trends such as fee compression, the shift to alternatives, T+1 settlement, cloud adoption, and evolving regulatory frameworks (e.g. DORA, AIFMD, MiFID).

• Strong knowledge of SimCorp Dimension, SimCorp One, or competing front-to-back investment management platforms.

• Solid grounding in enterprise and solution architecture — able to engage credibly with client architects, CTOs, and IT leadership on integration patterns, data design, and platform decisions, and to translate technical complexity into clear business value narratives.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms and deployment models, including public cloud providers (Azure, AWS, or GCP), hybrid and private cloud strategies, and the considerations financial services firms face around cloud adoption, data residency, and operational resilience.

• Understanding of the broader investment technology stack — including APIs and event-driven integration, data and analytics platforms, reference and market data management, and how these components interact within a modern front-to-back architecture.

• Experience operating in complex, consultative, multi-stakeholder sales environments.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt messaging from operational to C-level audiences.

• Proficiency in PowerPoint and standard sales tooling.

• Comfort working with AI tools and a demonstrated ability to adopt and apply emerging technologies and methods — translating new capabilities into practical value in a client-facing context.

• Language skills: English required; additional European languages are advantageous.

**Benefits

**SimCorp provides a range of benefits that may influence decisions regarding job offers. With operations in more than 30 offices globally, the benefits package can differ depending on the country. SimCorp implements a global hybrid work policy, requiring employees to be in the office two days per week and permitting remote work on other days. Additional information about location-specific benefits is available from the recruiter.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

_**At Trackunit, our IrisX industry cloud platform unlocks insights, benchmarks, and innovation through connected construction data. As a Solution Delivery Engineer, you’ll help customers successfully implement and adopt Manager and IrisX, making these platforms part of their everyday operations.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer engagement. You’ll configure solutions, build integrations, and work with customer teams to translate their needs into practical results. Along the way, you’ll collaborate with colleagues across Trackunit and explore a wide range of technologies and customer environments.

****What’s in it for you

******A broad technical playground

Depending on the project, you could use Python and SQL, JavaScript or TypeScript, REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks and Databricks. jobs.occupation: Data manager for Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Futures, Land-CRAFT, Department of Agroecology, Aarhus University
jobs.description:
Department of Agroecology at Aarhus University, Denmark, is looking for a full-time Data manager to work at the Center for Landscape Research in Sustainable Agricultural Futures (Land-CRAFT).

Land-CRAFT addresses three of our major societal challenges - food security, climate change, and loss of biodiversity. With Center partners from University of Copenhagen, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology (Germany), and Colorado State University (USA), we bring together expertise in climate impact research, landscape analyses, biogeochemistry, agronomy, biology, and geography to develop solution – oriented research that extends across multiple spatial and temporal scales. Established in June 2022, Land-CRAFT has built a dynamic team to undertake both fundamental and applied research aimed to reduce the environmental impact of agricultural systems, specifically regarding greenhouse gas emissions. To reach our goals, we are using a combination of empirical, field-based approaches, digital technologies, including modelling and remote sensing, while closely interacting with stakeholders. The position we advertise here is aimed at supporting these activities with respect to data management. The new employee will become part of a support team with complementary skills and work collaboratively in an active and international research environment with diverse projects and people across Department of Agroecology.

The position is available from 1st March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The duration of the position is 3 years.

Responsibilities and tasks
Your main role as part of the support team at Land-CRAFT will be to support research activities of the staff and research students (at BSc, MSc, and PhD levels) in data management, analysis and statistics. This will include maintaining and supplementing relational databases used for process-based modelling and geospatial data analyses. Main responsibilities and tasks include:

• 
Organize, archive, and document data collected by the Land-CRAFT team, including with appropriate metadata protocols

• 
Manage data transfer/sharing among Center partners and external collaborators following FAIR data principles, AU rules and regulations, and GDPR rules

• 
Manage user access and permissions within the AU File system and user data on a computational server

• 
Create and manage a database on research outputs from the Center, including e.g., publications, citations and other reports, to facilitate website updates, annual reports, and other communication platforms, as well as managing the Zenodo community

• 
Support staff and students with statistical and geospatial analyses (e.g. in R and Python)

• 
Support/manage data collection pipeline from instruments in the lab & field (including visualisation of data in e.g. Origin)

• 
Establish, maintain, and refine documentation regarding all data-related protocols (e.g. data policy, data management plans, etc.)

• 
Coordinating data management across the Department of Agroecology (about 20 % of time) in collaboration with the department’s data steward

Your profile
As a member of the Land-Craft support team, we expect you to plan and perform your tasks independently and initiate frequent feedback and communication with Land CRAFT researchers and students. The position requires that you can communicate with and support students and scientists from BSc to Professor levels, including attention to detail and quality (QA/QC) and an affinity for knowledge-sharing, e.g., in working with students as they learn to manage their own data. You have a high proficiency in English, are culturally sensitive, and can work in a large group of diverse colleagues and students. At Land-CRAFT we emphasize good relationships among colleagues and students. It is therefore important that you have a positive and open personality, stay engaged with emerging challenges and opportunities, and are ready to support colleagues when needed.

Qualifications

• 
MSc in data science, agroecology, geoscience, biology, ecology, environmental science, mathematics, geography (or related fields)

• 
Knowledge and understanding of data management plans, metadata systems, archiving practices

• 
Experience in statistical analysis; knowledge of R or Python, as well as visualisation platforms

• 
Good collaboration and communications skills across different groups of employees,

• 
High level of English proficiency and cultural sensitivity

• 
Interest in and willingness to acquire general knowledge about Land-CRAFT’s research areas

• 
Familiarity with the Danish administrative structures or Danish language.

Workplace
The place of work is Aarhus University, Ole Worms Alle 3, DK-8000 Aarhus C. The affiliation will be with the Department of Agroecology.

Who we are
At the Department of Agroecology, our main goal is to contribute to sustainable solutions to some of the world’s biggest problems within the areas of soil, plants, animals, humans, and the environment. We want to make a difference by contributing to both fundamental knowledge generation and the attainment of sustainable production systems via innovative research, contracted policy advice, and education. We offer professional laboratories, greenhouses, semi-field, and field-scale research facilities, advanced computing capacities as well as an extensive national and international researcher network. The department consists of nine research sections with around 350 highly skilled employees, of which approximately 50% are scientific staff. More information can be found here.
We believe in encouraging inclusion, acceptance, and understanding by employing staff who bring unique perspectives to our department.

What we offer

• 
A collaborative, international research environment that combines high academic standards with an informal and supportive atmosphere. We value accountability, curiosity, flexibility, and teamwork in everything we do.

• 
An inclusive and respectful workplace culture, where mutual trust, kindness, and professional dialogue are part of daily life. We encourage open communication and develop a cohesive sense of community across teams and disciplines.

• 
A flexible working environment that supports work-life balance and individual needs.

• 
An active institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion – in recruitment, career development, and everyday interactions.

• 
An innovative and meaningful workplace where your work contributes to solving real-world challenges. No two days are alike, and we welcome creative thinking and new ideas.

• 
Support for international researchers and their families, including Relocation Service and an Expat Partner Programme

Contact information
More information can be obtained from Klaus Butterbach-Bahl (klaus.butterbach bahl@agro.au.dk).

Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions..You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

About Aarhus University

Aarhus University is an academically diverse and research-intensive university with a strong commitment to high-quality research and education and the development of society nationally and globally. The university offers an inspiring research and teaching environment for its 37,500 students, including PhD students, and has 9,000 employees (full-time equivalents) and an annual revenue of EUR 1.2 billion. Learn more at international.au.dk
